# GIF encoder

`gifenc.js` is the ES module distribution of [gifenc 1.0.3](https://github.com/mattdesl/gifenc), downloaded from `https://unpkg.com/gifenc@1.0.3/dist/gifenc.esm.js` on 2026-10-04. It is used for GIF framing and LZW compression. Palette generation and dithering are implemented in `../export/quantize.js`.

The encoder is MIT-licensed, copyright Matt DesLauriers. The distribution's license is included as `gifenc-LICENSE.md`. The file is served locally; exports do not fetch an encoder from a CDN.
